Some shotguns focus on decimation or precision, but few prioritize concealability, which is why the JKE-8 Musashi stands out. Released not too long after Kang Tao’s L-69 Zhuo, the Musashi takes the core of a Yukimura and reconfigures it for shell loads while retaining the smartlinking, 3-round burst mode, and slim size. Though less potent than the Zhuo, the Musashi competes well enough among the minimum-wage consumer bracket for Arasaka’s ego to stay mostly intact.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Shotgun • Skill: Handgun • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 6 (Shell Only) • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Shotgun Shell

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When using Autofire with this weapon, it expends 3 Shells instead of 4.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
